tagline: The gateway to Sabiha Gökçen Airport and Istanbul's far Asian shore — a growing district with a marina and ferry connections to the Princes' Islands.

items.name: Viaport Marina Kafeler
items.description: A waterfront marina complex with cafés and restaurants. The most pleasant part of Pendik to spend time in.

items.name: Pendik Sahil Restoranları
items.description: Waterfront restaurants along the Pendik coast with Princes' Islands views. Good fresh fish at honest prices.

items.name: Ferry to Princes' Islands
items.description: Pendik has ferry connections to the Princes' Islands — useful for eastern Asian side residents who want to avoid going back to the city centre.

tips: Pendik is on the M4 metro line — the last stop before Sabiha Gökçen Airport (one more stop).
Primarily a transit point for the airport rather than a destination in itself.
The marina area (Viaport) is the most developed leisure destination in the district.
Much more affordable housing than central Asian side areas — popular with airport staff.
